_readme: Seed (display-only) listings for npm run seed:listings.
- city / locality: the SLUG (preferred) or exact name of an existing City / Locality.
- purpose: 'sale' or 'rent'. price = sale price (sale) or monthly rent (rent).
- propertyType: flat | independent-house | villa | plot | commercial-shop | office | pg | warehouse
- bedrooms (optional): '1rk','1','2','3','4','5plus'. area = usable sqft (optional but recommended).
- images: FULL Cloudinary URLs you already uploaded (the script never downloads or scrapes).
- Every imported listing is set isSeed=true, status=approved, seedExpiresAt=+30 days, dealerId=null.
Delete this _readme block (and this file's name) or copy to your own JSON before importing.
